archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with High-Contrast Swiss

mono.purpose: Transaction IDs, OTPs, Amounts, Technical Data

primary.usage: Brand anchor, Primary CTAs, Header backgrounds (if dark), Key balances

secondary.usage: Secondary CTAs, Alert dots, Kinetic triggers, Mobile Money deposit buttons

background.usage: Global app background. Warm tinted off-white.

surface.usage: Cards, Modals, Dropdowns. Must include a 1px border.

dashboard.strategy: Top-left hero metric (Wallet Balance). Progressive disclosure: show summary first, detail on demand.
dashboard.admin_patron: Modular widgets, Cards for glanceable KPIs, wide Tables for investigation.
dashboard.student_parent: Mobile-first, simple vertical flow with bento grid on desktop.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid backgrounds. Max 8px border-radius (`rounded-md`). 1px subtle border (`border-black/5` or `border-neutral-200`). Minimal to zero drop shadows.
surfaces.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism if scrolling: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5`. Solid if not scrolling.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. No cramped elements.

components.strategy: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Use customized Shadcn for interactivity (Tabs, Select, Dialogs, Tables).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never use native inputs.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or sharp (`rounded-md`). Explicit hover states required (e.g., `hover:bg-[#123022] hover:text-white`).
components.tables: Clean, technical look. Border-collapse, subtle borders on bottom of rows. Highlight row on hover.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Color-blind friendly palettes. Single-metric focus.
components.icons: Use `lucide-react`. 20-24px size. Stroke width 1.5 for elegance.

motion.hover: Slight lift (`-translate-y-[1px]`) and subtle shadow (`shadow-sm`) for cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform`. NEVER use `transition-all`.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the shape of the content, or subtle pulse. No full screen spinners if possible.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid. Use 1px borders to separate dashboard zones (The Technical Look).
visual_enhancers.texture: Add an SVG noise overlay with 2-3% opacity over the main hero balance card to remove digital flatness.

campus_background.description: Clean school campus architecture. Use for Login/Register split-screen backgrounds.

student_profile.description: Student on campus. Use for placeholder profile or parent dashboard 'Linked Student' cards.

mobile_payment.description: Contactless mobile payment. Use for Deposit Flow marketing or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use emojis (🤖, 💡, 🎯, etc.) for icons or empty states. Use lucide-react icons.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='deposit-submit-btn'`).
Do NOT use complete `transparent` backgrounds on headers or dropdowns. Ensure solid or glassmorphism backgrounds for readability.
Do not use generic 'card' looks with huge drop shadows. Use flat designs with 1px borders.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. Do not rely on inheritance.
Apply `IBM Plex Mono` to all currency amounts and transaction IDs to ensure tabular lining and financial precision.
Never leave empty image placeholders (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Ensure the dashboard uses a 'progressive disclosure' pattern—show top KPIs (balance) first, then detailed tables below.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text). Test text over the Forest Green primary color.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast than default. e.g., `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A4331] focus:ring-offset-2`.
